e_a4_fault_injection.late_final: A protocol helper first returned a completed turn without final and later appended a final to that same turn. The production collector retained its pending cursor, assigned the late final once to the original turn and cleared the pending state.
e_a4_fault_injection.disconnect: The protocol helper closed its stream during thread/turns/list. The production collector persisted source_unavailable without advancing the checkpoint, then recovered full turns from the same source without losing the visible gap.
e_a4_fault_injection.scope: These are controlled fault injections of production collection paths; spontaneous native late-final and active-host disconnect were not observed.

unsuccessful_probes.first_host_wait: An outside-worktree write probe remained agentWait:null while a hook ran; its target file was unchanged and the terminal was stopped.
unsuccessful_probes.late_inject: Public thread/inject_items did not add an assistant item to an already completed turn, so it was not used as late-final evidence.
